name: Itto……～Ryou Teippai no Hanataba o Kijo ni～
original_name: 一途……～両手いっぱいの花束を貴女に～
source:
A young boy and a young girl are raised in the ways of love
living their daily lives in a small town.

Konmamion presents a sweet, pure love l*li x shota
"scenario adventure game" created with RPG Maker,
featuring cute characters who discover a secret truth within
their idyllic storybook art world.

-Google Translated from DLsite Page
